# Mantle Clothing

> Premium technical apparel for law enforcement, first responders, and outdoor professionals. Purpose-built tactical clothing designed by cops, for cops — waterproof, articulated, and field-tested.

Mantle Clothing makes quality, purpose-built clothing for those who work in demanding environments. Co-founded by range instructor William Petty after 200+ days a year training police officers, the brand merges high-end outdoor performance with tactical functionality. Garments feature articulated cuts, integrated D3O knee protection, waterproof European fabrics, and purpose-built pockets designed for real operational use — not for fashion. Mantle is a US-based company; the brand name reflects historical garments worn by those who braved the elements to farm, protect, and build.
